author: More Perfect Union
description:
Iowa cancer rates are growing faster than anywhere else in the nation, and industrial agriculture pig farming appears to be the culprit.

Research scientist Chris Jones has sounded the alarm about rising cancer rates, and now he's running to be the state's next Agriculture Secretary.

[Part 2 of 2]
title: We investigated why cancer could be the decisive election issue in Iowa, Part 2
